08464 tachmac {takh-mawce'}

源自 02554; TWOT - 678b; 陽性名詞

AV - nigh hawk 2; 2

1) 公鴕鳥, 也有可能是貓頭鷹或燕子
 1a) 一種在宗教儀式上被視為不潔的鳥類
record.edic_text:
08464 tachmac {takh-mawce'}

from 02554; TWOT - 678b; n m

AV - nigh hawk 2; 2

1) a ceremonially unclean bird
   1a) a name of the male ostrich
   1b) (CLBL) probably the great owl
   1c) perhaps an extinct bird, exact meaning unknown
